headline: Planning Custom Cabinetry for Your Renovation: Complete Guide
articleBody:
Custom cabinetry transforms a standard kitchen or bathroom remodel into an organized, beautifully tailored living space. Here is how the process works from first sketches to the final drawer adjustment.

Overview and Key Benefits
Custom cabinetry maximizes every square inch of your room. Unlike modular boxes that use filler strips to hide dead space, custom builds provide durable construction, premium hardware, and personalized storage configurations.

Process Breakdown
1. Field Measurement and Layout: Evaluating wall plumbness, ceiling heights, window clearances, and appliance specifications on site.
2. Shop Drawings and Sign-Off: Reviewing detailed elevations, drawer locations, crown moulding profiles, and finish selections before production.
3. Build and Finish: Crafting cabinet boxes, face frames, and custom doors with durable conversion finishes.
4. Professional Installation: Scribing face frames to your walls, securing heavy uppers to wall studs, and micro-adjusting soft-close hinges and drawer slides.

What Can Change the Right Choice
Lead times for true custom casework range from 8 to 16 weeks depending on material selections and finish complexity. Starting cabinet planning early in your remodeling schedule ensures cabinets arrive precisely when the room framing and rough-ins are ready.
